_metadata.author: drafting-subagent-x02-c
_metadata.rules: x02 drafting rules (uncovered words first, no original-50, owner style examples, one-word hints)

clues.wordAConnection: Joey is one of the six Friends
clues.wordBConnection: A baby kangaroo is a joey
clues.revealExplanation: Joey Tribbiani and a baby kangaroo share a name, and both live with a lot of hopping around.

clues.wordAConnection: Acorns are the seeds of oak trees
clues.wordBConnection: Squirrels bury acorns for winter
clues.revealExplanation: Plenty of mighty oaks started as an acorn a squirrel forgot to dig up.

clues.wordAConnection: A butterfly is the end result of metamorphosis
clues.wordBConnection: A caterpillar begins the metamorphosis
clues.revealExplanation: Metamorphosis turns a crawling caterpillar into a flying butterfly.

clues.wordAConnection: A butterfly emerges from a chrysalis
clues.wordBConnection: A caterpillar forms a chrysalis to transform
clues.revealExplanation: Inside the chrysalis, a caterpillar rebuilds itself into a butterfly.

clues.wordAConnection: Slugs leave a trail of slime
clues.wordBConnection: Snails glide along on slime
clues.revealExplanation: Slugs and snails both travel on a carpet of their own slime.

clues.wordAConnection: Tusks are made of ivory
clues.wordBConnection: Woolly mammoths had huge curved tusks
clues.revealExplanation: Mammoth tusks are ivory, and some grew longer than 10 feet.

clues.wordAConnection: The giant saguaro cactus is a symbol of Arizona
clues.wordBConnection: Phoenix is the capital of Arizona
clues.revealExplanation: Arizona's state flower is the saguaro cactus blossom, and its capital is Phoenix.

clues.wordAConnection: Medusa's gaze turned people to stone
clues.wordBConnection: Many statues are carved from stone
clues.revealExplanation: Medusa made statues the easy way: one look and you were stone.

clues.wordAConnection: Loch Ness is a lake in the Scottish Highlands
clues.wordBConnection: The unicorn is Scotland's national animal
clues.revealExplanation: Scotland has a legendary lake monster and a mythical national animal: the unicorn.

clues.wordAConnection: Memphis was a capital of ancient Egypt
clues.wordBConnection: Elvis lived at Graceland in Memphis, Tennessee
clues.revealExplanation: There are two famous Memphises: one ruled by pharaohs, one by the King of Rock and Roll.

clues.wordAConnection: Peking is the older English name for Beijing
clues.wordBConnection: Peking duck is a famous roast duck dish
clues.revealExplanation: Peking duck is named for the city we now call Beijing.

clues.wordAConnection: The Blue Fairy brings Pinocchio to life
clues.wordBConnection: Pinocchio is a wooden puppet
clues.revealExplanation: Pinocchio was a wooden puppet until the Blue Fairy made him a real boy.

clues.wordAConnection: Smog is the fog half of the blend
clues.wordBConnection: Smog is the smoke half of the blend
clues.revealExplanation: The word smog was coined by squashing smoke and fog together.

clues.wordAConnection: Everest is in the Himalayas
clues.wordBConnection: Everest has the highest summit on Earth
clues.revealExplanation: Everest's summit sits about 29,000 feet up in the Himalayas.

clues.wordAConnection: Desert heat creates mirages
clues.wordBConnection: An oasis is a green spot in a desert
clues.revealExplanation: In the desert, an oasis is real water and a mirage only looks like it.

clues.wordAConnection: A mirage often looks like a pool of water
clues.wordBConnection: An oasis is a desert spring of water
clues.revealExplanation: A thirsty traveler hopes for an oasis and dreads a mirage: one has water, one only fakes it.

clues.wordAConnection: Maple sap is boiled down into syrup
clues.wordBConnection: Pine trees ooze sticky sap
clues.revealExplanation: Maple sap ends up on your pancakes, while pine sap mostly ends up on your hands.

clues.wordAConnection: The Grinch tried to steal Christmas
clues.wordBConnection: The Grinch is famously green
clues.revealExplanation: Dr. Seuss's green Grinch stole Christmas, then his heart grew three sizes.

clues.wordAConnection: Electricity flows as a current
clues.wordBConnection: A stream has a current
clues.revealExplanation: Electricity and a stream both have currents, but only one is safe to wade in.

clues.wordAConnection: Earth's outer layer is the crust
clues.wordBConnection: A pie has a crust
clues.revealExplanation: Earth and pie both have a crust, though only one has a filling of molten rock.

clues.wordAConnection: Storks are said to bring babies
clues.wordBConnection: The stork makes a famous special delivery
clues.revealExplanation: In folklore, the stork handles all baby deliveries.

clues.wordAConnection: Chicago is famous for deep-dish pizza
clues.wordBConnection: Chicago is nicknamed the Windy City
clues.revealExplanation: The Windy City is also the home of deep-dish pizza.

clues.wordAConnection: Density depends on mass
clues.wordBConnection: Density depends on volume
clues.revealExplanation: Density is mass divided by volume, which is why a brick sinks and a beach ball floats.

clues.wordAConnection: Shout in a cave and you hear an echo
clues.wordBConnection: An echo is sound bouncing back
clues.revealExplanation: Caves make great echo chambers: your own sound comes bouncing back.

clues.wordAConnection: Orbit is a brand of chewing gum
clues.wordBConnection: Satellites orbit Earth
clues.revealExplanation: Satellites go into orbit, and so can a stick of gum.

clues.wordAConnection: Malaria is a serious disease
clues.wordBConnection: Mosquitoes spread malaria
clues.revealExplanation: Malaria is a disease spread by the bite of certain mosquitoes.

clues.wordAConnection: Pencil lead is not lead at all but graphite
clues.wordBConnection: A pencil's core is graphite
clues.revealExplanation: Surprise: pencil lead contains no lead, just graphite and clay.

clues.wordAConnection: The humerus is the upper arm bone
clues.wordBConnection: Humerus sounds like humorous
clues.revealExplanation: The funny bone sits right by the humerus, which explains a lot.

clues.wordAConnection: Orville and Wilbur were the Wright brothers
clues.wordBConnection: The Wright brothers made the first powered airplane flight
clues.revealExplanation: In 1903 two bicycle-shop brothers named Wright made the first powered flight.

clues.wordAConnection: Gunpowder was invented in China
clues.wordBConnection: Fireworks are powered by gunpowder
clues.revealExplanation: Chinese alchemists invented gunpowder, and fireworks soon followed.

clues.wordAConnection: Shark cage diving puts people in a cage
clues.wordBConnection: Scuba divers sometimes swim with sharks
clues.revealExplanation: In shark cage diving, the people are the ones in the cage.

clues.wordAConnection: The runt is the smallest of the litter
clues.wordBConnection: A runt pig is the star of Charlotte's Web
clues.revealExplanation: Charlotte's Web begins with Fern saving Wilbur, the runt of the litter.

clues.wordAConnection: Wilbur was the runt of his litter
clues.wordBConnection: Wilbur is the pig in Charlotte's Web
clues.revealExplanation: Wilbur the pig was saved twice: once as a runt, once by a spider.

clues.wordAConnection: Peter Pan's crocodile swallowed a ticking clock
clues.wordBConnection: A clock goes tick
clues.revealExplanation: Captain Hook always knew the crocodile was coming: he could hear the clock ticking.

clues.wordAConnection: The Colosseum stands in Rome
clues.wordBConnection: The Colosseum was ancient Rome's giant stadium
clues.revealExplanation: Rome's Colosseum held about 50,000 fans, a stadium nearly 2,000 years ago.

clues.wordAConnection: The Minotaur comes from Greek mythology
clues.wordBConnection: The Minotaur lived inside the Labyrinth
clues.revealExplanation: In Greek myth, Theseus slew the Minotaur and found his way out of the Labyrinth.

clues.wordAConnection: Haiku comes from Japan
clues.wordBConnection: A haiku is a short poem
clues.revealExplanation: A haiku is Japanese poetry in three short lines of 5, 7 and 5 syllables.

clues.wordAConnection: Toad is Mario's mushroom-headed friend
clues.wordBConnection: A toadstool is a kind of mushroom
clues.revealExplanation: Toad wears a mushroom cap, and toadstool is another name for a mushroom.

clues.wordAConnection: A skull and crossbones warns of poison
clues.wordBConnection: The crossbones sit under the skull
clues.revealExplanation: The skull and crossbones means poison on a bottle and pirates on a flag.

clues.wordAConnection: Movies compete for Oscars
clues.wordBConnection: Oscar the Grouch lives in a trash can
clues.revealExplanation: One Oscar goes to the best movie; the other lives in a trash can on Sesame Street.

clues.wordAConnection: Planes take off from an airport runway
clues.wordBConnection: Models strut down the runway
clues.revealExplanation: A runway launches planes at the airport and outfits at a fashion show.

clues.wordAConnection: Captain Nemo commands the Nautilus
clues.wordBConnection: Nemo is the clownfish in Finding Nemo
clues.revealExplanation: Jules Verne's Captain Nemo explored the deep long before Pixar's little clownfish.

clues.wordAConnection: The Swiss Army knife comes from Switzerland
clues.wordBConnection: Switzerland is famous for fine watches
clues.revealExplanation: Switzerland gave the world precision watches and a knife with a tool for everything.
